title: Search Products
description: Rank the catalog's products for a query, as the site's search does: each hit with its score and why it matched. The same as `radar product search`.

category.description: Search one category only, by its id

tag.description: Keep the products with this tag

semantic.description: Blend keyword ranking with vector similarity

title: Get Product
description: One product as its page shows it: its spec rows with the current source of each value, versions, offerings, lifecycle, successors, media and sources, with the label and unit of each spec. The same as `radar product get`.

title: Search Sources
description: The catalog's Sources and media Documents by address, vendor, type and date, newest first, to cite a source the catalog holds rather than propose it again. Every filter given must hold. The same as `radar source search`.

url.description: Text the address contains, in any case

vendor.description: An organization's id or slug: the sources and files on its website

type.description: A source type, or a document kind

since.description: Retrieved on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD

until.description: Retrieved on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD

limit.description: The most sources, and the most documents, to return

title: Submit Proposal
description: File a proposed change to the catalog for the founder to review: nothing changes until he approves it. Every change cites at least one source (search_sources finds the catalog's). A new product named or numbered as the one held product of its maker merges into it, as its edit; the same proposal filed again counts one more report. The same as `radar proposal submit`, by the agent and with its token.

files_on.description: What it does: adds records, changes held ones, makes two records of one thing one, or withdraws one

reason.description: Why, in a sentence the founder reads

subject.description: The record it is about: the product a new product's records hang on, or the held record it changes

changeset.description: The changes, as JSON text: {"changes": [{"op": "put", "entity": {a record with its id}, "reason": "...", "source_refs": ["src_..."]}, {"op": "retract", "id": "...", "reason": "...", "source_refs": [...]}]}

title: List My Proposals
description: The proposals this agent filed, newest first, a page at a time, with their status. The same as `radar proposal list --actor-kind agent --author <the agent>`.

status.description: Only the proposals in this status

title: Get Proposal Status
description: One of this agent's proposals: its status, the founder's note once he decided, and what it changes. Another agent's is refused. The same as `radar proposal show`.
